name: Story vlog (Neistat-style)
description: Energetic vlog: jump cuts inside speech with pauses trimmed tight, a day title and a short sign-off. Music-led cutting, push-in cuts and sped-up montages are listed as not available yet.
author: dax-editor contributors

beats.name: Open mid-action
beats.guidance: Start in the middle of something happening; no greeting.

beats.name: Story
beats.guidance: Jump cuts only where a natural pause allows; random cuts look like mistakes.

beats.name: Montage
beats.guidance: Quick shots cut to the music.

deferred.title: Music-led cutting
deferred.description: Choose the music first and cut to its beats.

deferred.title: Push-in as a cut
deferred.description: A digital push-in used as a jump cut.

deferred.title: Sped-up montage
deferred.description: Time-lapse footage for travel and process.

notes.text: Use only music you have the right to use: a licensed or CC0 library, or your own. Do not reuse a platform's in-app sound library on other platforms, and check that the licence covers paid ads if you promote the video.
Get consent from every identifiable person in the footage, and blur or crop anyone who has not agreed. Minors need a parent or guardian's consent.
Check local rules before flying a drone or filming in restricted places, and keep stunts safe.
The style name describes a publicly discussed editing pattern. This template is not affiliated with or endorsed by any creator, and it does not copy anyone's footage, graphics or captions.
